subject: Post-call: Discovery for Nova Analytics — next steps & rotating demo cadence
message_1_subject: Post-call: Discovery for Nova Analytics — next steps & rotating demo cadence
message_1_body:
Hi Sienna,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the 30 minutes. Quick recap and a concrete next step to lock a technical deep-dive/demo:

Highlights from discovery:
- Primary use case: real-time model inference for customer insights (streaming embeddings + reranking).
- Key constraints: sub-200ms 95p latency, multi-region (US + EU + APAC) availability, and SOC2 evidence for audit.
- Success metric: 30% lower per-token inference cost vs current managed endpoints, while keeping quality intact.

Proposed next step: 60-minute technical deep-dive where we walk through a short architecture map, run a quick workload sketch, and demo a focused flow (embedding -> retriever -> prompt). We recommend including engineering + platform folks who own network/VPC and the person who will verify SOC2 artifacts.

Because your team spans regions, I'm proposing a rotating schedule to make it fair for folks in each timezone. Three candidate time windows (all shown in UTC / local):

Option A (US-friendly):
- Tue June 1, 09:00–10:00 UTC (02:00 PT / 11:00 ET) — early for US west but mid-morning for east.
Option B (EU-friendly):
- Wed June 2, 14:00–15:00 UTC (16:00 CEST / 11:00 ET)
Option C (APAC-friendly):
- Thu June 3, 00:30–01:30 UTC (08:30 SGT / 17:30 AEST)

Cadence suggestion: Run the 60-minute deep-dive once now, then if you like the flow we can set up a 3-week rotating slot so each region sees a convenient time over the course of a quarter. That helps keep demos inclusive without burning the same engineers every week.

Please reply with your preferred option and any additional people to include (I've cc'd Marissa and Ben from Solutions). I attached a short one-pager with discovery notes and a provisional .ics (attached) to make calendar booking easy.

Attachments: Nova-Discovery-Notes.pdf, proposed-rotating-cadence.ics

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Perfect — thanks for confirming Option B.

Proposed 60-min agenda (tight):
1) 5m quick intros
2) 10m architecture & current pain points (your SRE / eng)
3) 25m focused demo: streaming embeddings pipeline + latency profile and a quick reranking example
4) 10m deployment conversation: VPC, KMS, data retention, and SOC2 artifacts
5) 10m next steps / success metrics / pilot scope

Logistics: I will send a calendar invite for Wed June 2, 14:00–15:00 UTC. Attached is an updated .ics with the slot and a one-pager that includes discovery notes. Ben (solutions engineer) will lead the demo; Marissa will jump in on the product/contract path.

Ben — would you prefer to run the demo with a 20–30 minute hands-on flow or a 25-min walkthrough + short Q&A? Also, Tom / Priya — any special compliance artifacts you'd like ahead of the call (ex: encryption-at-rest diagram, SOC2 scoping doc)? If you can point us to a place to upload sensitive docs (S3 presigned / secure Share), we'll prep before the call.

Attachments: proposed-rotating-cadence.ics, Nova-Discovery-Notes.pdf

Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
